cards.ex: I'm totally swamped with paperwork this week; I can barely breathe!
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta qog'ozbozlik bilan butunlay bandman; deyarli nafas ololmayapman!
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ish bilan juda band bo'lish, vaqt yo'qligi.

cards.ex: While it was a tough project, I see it as a great learning opportunity.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin loyiha bo'lsa ham, men uni ajoyib o'rganish imkoniyati deb bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Tajriba orqali o'rganish va rivojlanish uchun imkoniyat.

cards.ex: This new software will really raise the bar for our productivity.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi dasturiy ta'minot bizning unumdorligimiz uchun talabni oshiradi.
cards.uzDef: Standart yoki kutish darajasini yuqoriroq qilish.

cards.ex: She's a real go-getter; she's always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy faol inson; u doimo yangi imkoniyatlar qidiradi.
cards.uzDef: Faol, tashabbuskor va muvaffaqiyatga intiladigan inson.

cards.ex: Free coffee and flexible hours are some of the perks of the job.
cards.exUz: Bepul qahva va moslashuvchan soatlar - ishning ba'zi afzalliklari.
cards.uzDef: Ish bilan birga keladigan qo'shimcha foydalar yoki imtiyozlar.

cards.ex: We've had to put that project on the back burner due to budget cuts.
cards.exUz: Biz budjet qisqarishi sababli ushbu loyihani keyinga qoldirishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha e'tibor berilmaydigan yoki keyinga qoldirilgan narsa.

cards.ex: In a small company, you often have to wear multiple hats.
cards.exUz: Kichik kompaniyada siz ko'pincha ko'p vazifalarni bajarishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil rollarni yoki vazifalarni bir vaqtning o'zida bajarish.

cards.ex: Everyone has to pay their dues before they reach the top.
cards.exUz: Hamma tepaga chiqishdan oldin qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadiga erishish uchun kerakli tajriba va sabr-toqatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: An internship is a great way to get your foot in the door.
cards.exUz: Stajirovka - eshikni ochishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Ishga yoki sohada ish boshlash uchun birinchi imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritish.

cards.ex: They keep moving the goalposts; it's impossible to meet their expectations.
cards.exUz: Ular qoidalarni o'zgartirishda davom etmoqdalar; ularning umidlarini oqlashning iloji yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning talablarini yoki qoidalarini o'zgartirish, odatda qiyinlashtirish.

cards.ex: Let's have a blue-sky thinking session to come up with new ideas.
cards.exUz: Yangi g'oyalar bilan chiqish uchun ijodiy fikrlash sessiyasini o'tkazaylik.
cards.uzDef: Chegarasiz yoki amaliy cheklovlarsiz ijodiy fikrlash.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project's progress.
cards.exUz: Loyiha rivojlanishini muhokama qilish uchun kelasi hafta aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan qisqacha aloqada bo'lish, vaziyatni tekshirish.

cards.ex: Women still face a glass ceiling in many industries.
cards.exUz: Ayollar hanuzgacha ko'plab sohalarda shisha shiftga duch kelmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishga to'sqinlik qiladigan ko'rinmas to'siq.

cards.ex: It's important to dress for success when you go for a job interview.
cards.exUz: Ish suhbatiga borganda muvaffaqiyat uchun kiyinish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan kasb yoki ish joyida muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun munosib kiyinish.

cards.ex: We're looking for someone who is a real team player.
cards.exUz: Biz haqiqiy jamoa a'zosi bo'lgan odamni qidirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Jamoada yaxshi ishlaydigan, boshqalar bilan hamkorlik qiladigan inson.

cards.ex: She's on the fast track to becoming a senior manager.
cards.exUz: U katta menejer bo'lish yo'lida tezkor rivojlanishda.
cards.uzDef: Tez rivojlanish va muvaffaqiyatga erishish yo'lida bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's important to maintain a good work-life balance for your well-being.
cards.exUz: Sog'lig'ingiz uchun yaxshi ish va hayot muvozanatini saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasida sog'lom muvozanatni saqlash.

cards.ex: The company just landed a major deal with a new client.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yaqinda yangi mijoz bilan katta kelishuvga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatli kelishuvga erishish yoki shartnoma imzolash.

cards.ex: We need to tighten our belts to get through this recession.
cards.exUz: Bu inqirozdan o'tish uchun xarajatlarimizni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish yoki iqtisod qilish, odatda qiyin davrda.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishni boshlaganingizda, ishni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni yoki vaziyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, he got the axe during the company's restructuring.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, u kompaniyaning qayta tuzilishi paytida ishdan bo'shatildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatilish, ayniqsa xodimlar sonini qisqartirish natijasida.

cards.ex: She's been at the helm of the company for the past five years.
cards.exUz: U oxirgi besh yil davomida kompaniyani boshqarib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqarish yoki rahbarlik qilish.

cards.ex: I appreciate employees who take the initiative and solve problems on their own.
cards.exUz: Men o'z tashabbusi bilan ishlaydigan va muammolarni o'zlari hal qiladigan xodimlarni qadrlayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zidan biror narsani qilishni boshlash, hech kim aytmasdan.

cards.ex: She always goes above and beyond to help her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U doimo hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun zo'r harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidan ham ko'proq harakat qilish, a'lo natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: I've been working my tail off to finish this project on time.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun juda qattiq ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va ko'p ishlash.

cards.ex: The CEO received a golden handshake when he retired.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor nafaqaga chiqqanida saxiy to'lov oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatilganda katta miqdordagi to'lov yoki imtiyozlar.

cards.ex: It's getting late; let's call it a day and continue tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti; keling, ishni tugatamiz va ertaga davom ettiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Kun uchun ishni tugatish yoki to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Please keep me in the loop about any changes to the schedule.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, jadvaldagi har qanday o'zgarishlar haqida meni xabardor qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning rivojlanishi haqida xabardor qilish.

cards.ex: He needs to get a grip and stop panicking about the deadline.
cards.exUz: U o'zini tutishi va muddat haqida vahima qilishni to'xtatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z hissiyotlarini nazorat qilish, xotirjam bo'lish.

cards.ex: My boss will hit the ceiling if he finds out about this mistake.
cards.exUz: Agar xo'jayinim bu xato haqida bilsa, juda g'azablanadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanish yoki jahli chiqish.
